about: Nate Maray's campaign sheet. Edit this file after each scene and set rev to a new string. Equip, loadouts, and pinned tabs stay on the phone. See DATA_SCHEMA.md.

vitals.label: HEALTH
vitals.note: Brick to the cheek, scabbed shin

location: Nest chamber, tannery culvert, Old City

abilities.name: Arc Step
abilities.detail: Dissolve into a streak of lightning and reappear a short distance away along a line of sight. Anything in the path takes a jolt of lightning damage. Costs about 40% mana and 20% stamina. Cannot carry passengers.

racial.name: Momentum Affinity
racial.detail: Increased resistance to movement-restricting effects. Movement abilities have increased effect. Attacks made while moving deal increased damage. Does not add raw speed.

racial.name: Unknown Variable
racial.detail: Language adaptation. Can absorb essences, awakening stones, and skill books. Immune to identification and tracking.

racial.name: Pocket Space
racial.detail: 40-slot storage plus a coin counter. Only Nate can access it.

racial.name: Star Chart
racial.detail: Reveals the area as he explores.

missions.name: Something in the Pipe
missions.detail: Track down the creature raiding the tannery's drying racks and deal with it. Reward pending.

missions.name: Beneath the Old City
missions.detail: Find out what has made a home in the drains under Greenstone and where it nests. Reward pending.

missions.name: Warehouse Pests
missions.detail: Complete: paid 60 lesser, looted 9 lesser + 1 pelt.

missions.name: Rumour
missions.detail: Rumour: shimmering scaled creature surfacing near the Island reefs at dusk. Hide merchant pays iron. Gary says no.

missions.name: Cellar Dwellers
missions.detail: Wet Barrel tavern, Old City docks. One ratling escaped down a burrow, now bricked up. Mags expects you back once you're a real adventurer.

missions.name: Floorboard Feeders
missions.detail: Warehouse 9, Verdant Fields. Three mist eels cleared.

missions.name: Plumbing Problem
missions.detail: Waterfall shab. Reward: 5 iron spirit coins.

missions.name: The Evil Pit of Evil
missions.detail: Survive the ritual. Reward: Lightning Essence.

missions.name: Stranger in a Strange Land
missions.detail: Explore the estate grounds. Reward: Simple Pants.

log.title: Night in Old City
log.detail: Took the Cellar Dwellers job, killed two ratlings, ran home testing momentum, and crashed in room 32.

log.title: Greenstone
log.detail: 1 iron Island permit, tracking stone touched. Room 32 at Sailor's Watch for 2 nights. Registered at the Adventure Society with Albert; intake tomorrow morning. Window-shopped essences.

log.title: Barge and delta
log.detail: Sailed all night, meditating. Pitched the momentum hammer to Gary. Jason left at the delta; Nate stayed with the team.

log.title: Verdant Fields
log.detail: Hostel night, Floorboard Feeders filler, compass pointed upstream.

log.title: The road
log.detail: Fruit wagon, walled town cottage, Cascade rolled, flower brothers, earth elemental lesson.

essenceNotes.name: Cascade (invented confluence)
essenceNotes.detail: Chaining effects that spread from one target to the next. Locked for Lightning + Star + Spider; specific abilities roll on absorption. Only Lightning is locked in; other picks can still change.

essenceNotes.name: Still needed
essenceNotes.detail: A perception power and an aura ability, which every adventurer should have. These can come naturally.

achievements.name: Guardian Down. Guardian Up.
achievements.detail: Get struck by lightning from the inside. Voluntarily.

achievements.name: Stuck the Landing (Mostly)
achievements.detail: Use Arc Step for the first time without falling over. Knees don't count.

achievements.name: What's in a Name?
achievements.detail: Name your System. It will remember this kindness. And everything else.

achievements.name: Bait and Switch
achievements.detail: Use yourself as bait to lead a shab into someone else's leeches.

pocket.note: Transcendent, legendary. Points upstream toward the Mistrun source aperture. Keep hidden.

pocket.name: Vane ledger
pocket.note: Evidence of cellar deliveries. Gary warned not to sell it; show it to Rufus.

battle.title: Nest chamber, tannery culvert
battle.note: Past the bend, in the nest chamber. The injured adult is dead at your feet, skull crushed by the hammer. The leader and a second adult are charging side by side down the tunnel. The young one hangs back at the bend, hissing. Three blind pups wail in the nest.

charted.seen: Grounds explored for Stranger in a Strange Land; manor rooms and the cellar with the ritual pit.
Path down from the estate; the waterfall pool where the first shab was fought.
Streets, the inn and its courtyard, and the water channel from the Shell Shock fight.
The trail south toward the river, where the fruit wagon threw a wheel.
Gate, square, and the free stone cottage.
Where Jason fought the desert maw spider.
The village and its pond aperture; site of the earth elemental fight.
Docks and the east wharf, Warehouse 9 (Floorboard Feeders), and the teamsters' hostel.
The river west, the aqueduct, and the delta at dawn where Jason left.
The wharf, Old City streets, and the bridge with its permit booths.
Sailor's Watch (room 32, kitchen) and the transit station.
Administration lobby, intake waiting room, and intake room.
Taproom and the cellar from Cellar Dwellers (burrow now bricked up).
The street of smithy storefronts and the crossed-blades weapon shop.
Stairs, the front rows of chewed sacks, and most of the back under the lamp. Three ratlings at the back wall.

Past the bend in a low nest chamber. The injured adult is dead at Nate's feet. The leader and a second adult are charging down the tunnel. A young one hisses at the bend. Three blind pups wail in the nest.
